idea_relation: Operator-defined child question. It retains the high-IQR abstention action but replaces the parent's unrealizable taken-versus-skipped realized-fill comparison with a 15-minute quote-only round-trip P/L proxy on synthetic order intents. It does not measure actual execution-cost or adverse-fill outcomes.
source: 2020 broker server tick backfill verified by the existing quote-quality evaluator
intent_population: One synthetic one-ounce XAUUSD marketable entry at each 15-minute anchor from 08:30 through 15:45 UTC on each listed date, if prior quotes and entry/exit quotes satisfy freshness rules. Long when the latest pre-anchor mid exceeds the latest mid strictly before T-15 minutes; short when it is lower; no intent on an exact tie. Exit 15 minutes after the anchor. No actual strategy generated these orders.
quote_rule: Use the first source quote at or after entry T and exit T+15 minutes, each no more than five seconds late. Signal mids use the last source quotes strictly before T and T-15 minutes, each no more than 30 seconds old. A missing or stale quote marks the scheduled anchor ineligible before policy comparison.
take_value: Quote-only round-trip P/L in USD per ounce: long = exit bid - entry ask; short = entry bid - exit ask. No fills, commissions, financing, price impact or slippage are observed or assumed.
skip_value: Zero executed quote P/L. The unobserved counterfactual is the same intent's quote-only take value; overlay minus all-take value is the negative sum of take values for skipped intents. It is an estimate from the quote tape, not a realized skipped-order fill.

policies.iqr_overlay: Skip an eligible intent when its prior-30-minute spread IQR is greater than 0.085 USD per ounce; otherwise take.
policies.recent_spread_baseline: Skip an eligible intent when the previous completed 15-minute window's spread p95 is greater than 0.245 USD per ounce; otherwise take.

threshold_provenance: Both fixed thresholds are medians of already inspected 2020 development features in the existing quote-quality cases (IQR across 192 anchors; previous-window p95 across 186 consecutive-anchor pairs). They were selected with 2020 data visible. This measurement is not independent validation.
comparison: Report scheduled, eligible, ineligible and tied anchors; each policy's skipped and taken counts and quote-only P/L per ounce; overlay minus all-take and overlay minus recent-spread baseline per day and across days. Retain all days; no outcome-based filtering.
independence_unit: Day; six preselected dates only. Do not treat 15-minute anchors as independent trials.
cost_sensitivity: For any unknown round-trip non-spread cost c in USD per ounce per taken order, net policy value equals reported quote-only P/L minus c times the number of taken orders. Report break-even cost comparisons algebraically; do not claim broker-net profit.
visibility: Historical source available_at is unknown. This is retrospective event-time simulation, not historical decision replay or live executable pricing.
validation_boundary: Do not read 2021 quote outcomes in this study. A separate measurement design, source/cost checks and independent review are required before any 2021 evaluation.
